mintAuthority.summary: Ondo GM native managers issue GLDon on Ethereum, BNB and Solana; EVM beacon-owner timelocks can replace mint logic. OFT representation powers are segregated into Bridge Risk. D14: Native adminProcessMint can mint to a registered recipient without on-chain deposit or custody-attestation validation; issuance is economically unbounded.
mintAuthority.headline: Issuer managers can mint without on-chain backing validation; upgrade timelocks and periodic reconciliation do not impose an immutable issuance cap.

Verified adminProcessMint permits registered-recipient issuance without executable deposit or custody-attestation validation; the nominal legal issue volume is extendible and does not cap this path. Whole-program Trust & Transparency disclosures appoint Ankura to daily verification of all Ondo Stocks holdings and periodic investor-liability reconciliation, with monthly reports and no claimed issuer prudential supervision. The October 12 aggregate report includes Ondo Stocks, USDY and USDon; it does not establish GLDon-specific collateral weights, custody shares or reserve-to-liability financial assurance. The off-curve Solana upgrade authority's Squads topology is now freshly pinned, replacing the obsolete endpoint-unavailable statement. Exact Solana execution/bypass closure and human key independence remain open. Source-level code audits do not establish current financial assurance. No transaction was sent and no governed-issuance certificate is claimed.
